label: complete ammonia oxidation
definition: A nitrification metabolism in which a single organism oxidizes ammonia via nitrite to nitrate.
observations: One-organism complete ammonia-to-nitrate nitrification trait; absent from live METPO except for METPO:1000862 obsolete Complete ammonia oxidation, and distinct from the broader nitrification class that does not require both steps to occur in the same organism.
related_synonyms: complete nitrification by a single microorganism
